stories.title: Magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor
summary: Magic state cultivation offers an efficient alternative to resource-intensive distillation protocols; however, testing the proposal’s assumptions represents a challenging departure from quantum memory experiments.
We present an experimental study of magic state cultivation on a superconducting quantum processor.
We implement cultivation, including code-switching into a surface code, and develop a fault-tolerant measurement protocol to bound the magic state fidelity.

stories.title: Show HN: Hob - Open-source, on device alternative to Claude Cowork and ChatGPT
summary: Hob is a free, MIT-licensed desktop app for Mac, Windows and Linux that works on your files the way the Claude and ChatGPT desktop apps do, except the model runs on your own computer.

The main thing I noticed is that none of them could do what the ChatGPT and Claude apps do with your files, e.g. read and change files in a folder, look at images, run code in a sandbox, draw a chart.

I couldn't find anything that could easily parse images and bigger PDFs.The OSS solutions that were more advanced all seemed to default to hosted models (either OSS or closed), which defeats the entire point of the privacy that on-device OSS offers.
